sourceFilesPolicy: Private originals retain exact bytes; public modules use neutral identifiers and redacted original locators with originalSha256 retained. Motion, geometry, media and timing remain unchanged.
dependencyScope: Selected runtime branches and import closure only; unrelated source branches are retained for provenance but their media are not copied.

runtime.browser: Remotion-managed Chrome or explicit CHROME_EXECUTABLE environment override.
runtime.warning: NativeSceneClock uses pinned Remotion internals. Reverify before changing versions.

mediaClockRestoration.mapping: Freeze maps each excerpt output frame to localFrameRange[0] + outputFrame in the exact original scene.
mediaClockRestoration.sequenceContext: Original scene has zero cumulatedNegativeFrom and full native duration. Inner positive Sequences preserve their original media trim and playback-rate clocks.
mediaClockRestoration.compositionMetadata: The clock subtree restores the full original scene duration in CompositionManager metadata to avoid useTimelinePosition clamping to excerpt duration.
mediaClockRestoration.guard: ClockGuard reads useCurrentFrame for every rendered frame and throws if it differs from the requested original scene frame.
mediaClockRestoration.audio: Independent example PCM audio remains outside the clock subtree.
mediaClockRestoration.runtimeConstraint: Requires the pinned Remotion 4.0.473 runtime; internals must be reverified before any version upgrade.
rejectedAttempts: Negative excerpt Sequence changed cumulatedNegativeFrom and shifted rate != 1 media.
Freeze with restored SequenceContext but short composition metadata clamped long native frames.

switchLimit: includeSubtitles=false on 102-02 first two frames replaces the originally compressed captioned S04 media layer with exact InstallV7 source, retaining the Incoming composition and original native clock. This optional clean branch is not a claim of compressed pixel identity.

verification.originalVerification: The original package passed exact provenance, TypeScript, stills and continuous visual/technical review before public projection. Public projection verification is recorded separately.

publicProjection.pathChanges: Machine paths and private original locators are redacted; internal library names and provenance identifiers use neutral public aliases. Original source hashes, licenses, motion, geometry, frame ranges and clocks are retained.
publicProjection.npmDependencies: Pinned source/package.json and source/package-lock.json; install locally with npm ci.
publicProjection.derivedMediaPolicy: Public install recording account region is irreversibly masked. Other 40 example dependency files retain original bytes. Original private media and official extracted preview identity remain unchanged.
publicProjection.attributionPolicy: Neutral identifiers do not claim original authorship. Third-party source hashes and applicable license notices are retained.
